zen.text: Ulamog, one of the three Eldrazi titans, is first bound within the Eye of Ugin by Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin, but he and his brethren eventually emerge and unravel Zendikar's natural forces.

Jori En warns the defenders of Sea Gate that Ulamog is coming, and Gideon, Nissa and Jace trap him in a ring of hedrons, with Gideon holding the titan's attention while the others raise and activate the network.
The prison does not last, because a winged demon knocks a hedron out of alignment and the ring collapses, so Ulamog is freed and moves toward Sea Gate once more.
Finally Chandra leads the group baiting Ulamog, and when Nissa weaves the leylines to hold the titans and sends Zendikar's mana through Chandra, the leylines catch fire and both titans are destroyed.

roe.text: Ulamog arrives on Zendikar with Kozilek and Emrakul, and the three are sealed in a prison of mana and stone and sink into dormancy.
Cultists in Akoum, infected by his creative force, perform rituals that loosen the prison, and twelve of them become the first vampire bloodchiefs, enslaved to Ulamog.
The meeting of Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace in the Eye of Ugin loosens the bonds, and the Eldrazi rise to feed again, with his brood causing the Slaughter at Sea Gate.

cns.text: Ulamog returns to Zendikar, and the Eldrazi swarm devastates Nissa's Joraga tribe, leaving her pinned under a fallen tree too drained to planeswalk as his shadow passes over her, devouring life from the land.
A human man pulls her free and heals her as Ulamog closes in.

bfz.text: Ulamog is the titan whose lineage ravages Bala Ged and who, with Kozilek and Emrakul, is revealed to be the true source of the merfolk god Ula.
Jace realizes Ulamog is drawn to crowded places, so Sea Gate will become a tomb, and Jori En carries the warning to Gideon.
Gideon's army retakes Sea Gate, and Nissa raises sunken hedrons while Jace triggers them, trapping the titan. Ugin has told Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed.
Ob Nixilis then knocks the hedrons out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and calling Kozilek up from beneath Zendikar, so two titans are left rampaging.

ogw.text: Ulamog stands ready to succumb at Sea Gate when Kozilek arises, and both titans head for Halimar Basin.
Jace and Nissa devise a plan to destroy the titans permanently, even though it breaks Jace's promise to Ugin, and Nissa traces the leyline pattern that anchors them.
When the binding locks and the titans begin to tear apart, Chandra attacks, Nissa channels leyline mana to her, and her fire incinerates both Ulamog and Kozilek.
